title: Local verification cannot detect non-transportability: a cohomological theory of context preservation in agentic reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.11252v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic AI systems routinely transport conclusions across biological, clinical and financial contexts, and the emerging safeguard is local verification: checking at each step that the entity is representable in the chosen tool, that parameters are compatible, and that outputs cohere with the plan. We prove this class of safeguard is structurally incomplete. Modelling a covering of context space by its nerve and evidence by a real-valued 1-cochain, an agent chaining evidence performs path integration: its conclusion is path-independent if and only if the cochain is exact, and disagreement between valid reasoning paths is exactly the holonomy of a first Cech cohomology class. Hodge decomposition partitions evidence conflict into a gradient part (calibration), a curl part (local inconsistency, visible at triple overlaps) and a harmonic part. Our central result is that no family of simplex-supported consistency checks can distinguish omega f

translated_title: 局部验证无法检测不可传递性：智能体推理中上下文保持的上同调理论
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.11252v1 公告类型：新 摘要：智能体AI系统经常在生物学、临床和金融等不同上下文中传递结论，而新兴的安全保障措施是局部验证：在每一步检查实体是否能在所选工具中表示、参数是否兼容、输出是否与计划一致。我们证明这类保障措施在结构上是不完备的。通过神经覆盖对上下文空间进行建模，并将证据建模为实值1-上链，智能体在链式推理时执行路径积分：其结论仅在当且仅当上链是精确时与路径无关，而有效推理路径之间的分歧恰好是第一Cech上同调类的和乐。Hodge分解将证据冲突划分为梯度部分（校准）、旋度部分（局部不一致，在三重重叠处可见）和调和部分。我们的核心结果是，没有任何基于单纯形支持的兼容性检查族能够区分ω f。
tldr: 本文证明智能体推理中的局部验证方法在结构上无法检测跨上下文的不可传递性，并首次引入上同调理论形式化刻画了上下文保持的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that local verification methods in agentic reasoning are structurally incapable of detecting non-transportability across contexts, and introduces a cohomological framework to formally characterize the limits of context preservation.
